Cada mapa deve ser adicionado uma vez. P: Each map must be added only once. To evaluate multiple fields of the same layer, use vector attribute evaluation.
Cada polígono recebe uma assinatura indi: Each polygon receives an individual signature. Overlapping regions are analyzed separately, and their areas should not be added together.
Calcula a assinatura temática da área de: Computes the thematic signature of the area defined by the UNION of all input polygons: categorical raster classes, pixels, percentages and area (ha in a projected CRS). Overlapping polygons are not double-counted. Pixels are selected by their centers (ALL_TOUCHED=FALSE). This version does not report results for individual features. The vector is reprojected to the raster CRS when needed.
Calcula a média ponderada das notas das: Computes the weighted mean of class scores for each raster. Select categorical rasters in the order of the JSON entries. Assign a positive weight to each theme and scores between 0 and 10 to ALL classes. Weights are normalized by their sum; they do not need to sum to 100. Areas with NoData in any raster are NoData in the result. Rasters must share the same CRS, grid, resolution and extent. Example with two rasters:

Identifica as transições de classe entre: Identifies class transitions between two categorical rasters. The output map stores consecutive integer identifiers. The CSV table relates each identifier to the source and destination classes, pixel count, percentage and area (ha for a projected CRS). NoData in either period excludes the pixel. Grids must be aligned.

Mann–Kendall só será calculado com 5 ou: Mann–Kendall is computed only with five or more valid dates; eight to ten or more are recommended. With only two dates, the report indicates “not applicable”.

NoData values are excluded; interval boundaries are stored in VALOR_MIN and VALOR_MAX. The CRS comes from the TIFF unless explicitly overridden.

Projeto independente inspirado nos proce:
Independent project inspired by Vista SAGA/UFRJ workflows. It contains no code from the original software. Verify the results before using them in technical studies.
Developer: Esdras Andrade — Institute of Geography, Development and Environment (IGDEMA), Federal University of Alagoas (UFAL).
